pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark, irregularly polygonal regions with high-contrast edge gradients. Patches exhibit moderate angularity with defined vertices. The spatial area of dark pigmentation significantly exceeds the area of the light negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming a multi-nodal topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent. Pathway thickness is narrow and consistent across the visible lateral neck and shoulder regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck and withers, consisting of dark, vertically oriented hair clusters against a light background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark avian silhouettes perched on the dorsal ridge and lateral neck, creating localized structural protrusions beyond the anatomical contour.
